whatIs: Skiper UI is a collection of more than 106 uncommon components for shadcn/ui, built with Tailwind CSS, Next.js and Motion. Each component is a single file, so it doesn't add extra packages, and it installs with the shadcn command.
It's a good fit when you want effects beyond the usual ones, like a dynamic island or an image reveal, in a project that already uses shadcn/ui.
uses: Add a mobile-style dynamic island to a website's navigation.
Give a landing page image reveal effects or cursor trails.
Install a single component with npx shadcn add without adding new dependencies.
caveats: Some of the components are premium and only unlock with a purchase.
It's designed for projects with shadcn/ui, Tailwind and Next.js.
Animated effects can be heavy on modest devices: test them on mobile.
pricingNote: There are free components with no account needed; the Premium plan costs $129 as a one-time payment, with no subscription.
idealFor: Projects with shadcn/ui that are looking for uncommon visual components.
